process: Retrieve exact Wikimedia Commons original file and verify hash/image dimensions. Compare perceptual dHash of original to preserved original archival preview. Resize full frame only, no crop. Publish only entries with release fields. Preserve original subject and site distinction.

rows.reason: Ferri's 1960 Carrara marble tableau is prominent. Knock Shrine owns this photograph under CC-BY-SA-4.0 but the licence to reproduce Ferri's still-protected sculpture within the photograph is not independently established.

rows.label_en: The original Grotto of Massabielle, Lourdes
rows.label_fr: La grotte originale de Massabielle, Lourdes
rows.alt_en: Original rocky Grotto of Massabielle at Lourdes, with the Marian niche and worshippers at the site
rows.alt_fr: Grotte originale de Massabielle à Lourdes, avec la niche de la Vierge et des pèlerins sur place
rows.caption_en: The original 1858 apparition site at Lourdes, photographed on 9 March 2026. The statue in the niche is associated with Joseph-Hugues Fabisch's nineteenth-century work; this is not a replica grotto.
rows.caption_fr: Site original des apparitions de 1858 à Lourdes, photographié le 9 mars 2026. La statue de la niche est associée à l'œuvre du XIXe siècle de Joseph-Hugues Fabisch ; il ne s'agit pas d'une reproduction de la grotte.
rows.rights_review: Source photo CC-BY-4.0, 2026 photographer Sotos. Nineteenth-century Fabisch statue (1864; sculptor died 1886) out of copyright. No modern sculpture is central.

rows.reason: Exact glass casket at Saint-Gildard confirmed, and photographer Jabonsbachek licensed photo CC-BY-SA-4.0; independent rights status for the 1925 bronze/glass shrine and wax face/hand masks not yet documented. Do not claim a photograph authenticates bodily incorruption.

rows.label_en: The tongue reliquary of Saint Anthony of Padua
rows.label_fr: Le reliquaire de la langue de saint Antoine de Padoue
rows.alt_en: Ornate Gothic gold reliquary displayed in the Treasury Chapel at Padua, associated with Saint Anthony's tongue
rows.alt_fr: Reliquaire gothique doré exposé dans la chapelle du Trésor à Padoue, associé à la langue de saint Antoine
rows.caption_en: The fifteenth-century reliquary for Saint Anthony's tongue, photographed on 27 April 2022. The photograph shows the historic container; authenticity of the relic is attributed to the basilica, not independently certified here.
rows.caption_fr: Reliquaire du XVe siècle de la langue de saint Antoine, photographié le 27 avril 2022. La photographie montre la châsse historique ; l'authenticité de la relique est attribuée à la basilique et n'est pas certifiée indépendamment ici.
rows.rights_review: 2022 photographer Elmiralaleh CC-BY-SA-4.0; reliquary attributed by basilica to Giuliano da Firenze (1436), out of copyright. Reflections and 960px width acceptable for gallery only.
